text: カウンター　つかってる　かい？

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is ongoing or done regularly; てる is the shortened spoken form. つかってる = 'are using'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい is a friendly, casual way to ask a yes-or-no question, used mostly by men. つかってる　かい = 'are you using it?'.
